title: Pork Chops With Cabbage
description:
Pork and cabbage are a wonderful combination. This dish is especially scrumptious, particularly on those golden Autumn days.
We’ve used the same basic technique as the pan grilled pork chops, but now filled up some of the roasting time with preparing the cabbage. You could also whip up some easy smashed potatoes while this is all getting together (boil, smash, butter, parsley, salt and pepper). If you like rye bread, but don’t eat it that often, this is a great meal to have it with.
START TO FINISH: 1 HOUR + 45 MIN
IF TIME PERMITS
Pork Chops With Cabbage
Preheat oven to 275 degrees.
Pat chops dry with paper towels. Using sharp knife, cut 2 slits, about 2 inches apart, through outer layer of fat and silver skin.
Sprinkle entire surface of each chop with 1 teaspoon salt. Place chops on wire rack set in rimmed baking sheet and let stand at room temperature 45 minutes (if time permits).
Season chops liberally with pepper; transfer baking sheet to oven. Cook around 30 minutes (or less if your chops are not 1 ½ inches thick), or until instant-read thermometer inserted into centers of chops and away from bones registers about 120 degrees.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a little olive oil over moderate heat, until just crisp.
Add the onion, and cook, stirring occasionally, until it begins to turn golden, about 2 minutes.
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops, preferably with the bone in,
1 ½ inches thick, about 12 ounces each
2 small red cabbages, halved lengthwise, cored, and thinly sliced
directions: Add the cabbage apples and turn with tongs until well coated. Stir in the red-wine vinegar, water, sugar, caraway seeds, ¾ teaspoon salt, and ¼ teaspoon pepper. Braise over moderately low heat for about 30 minutes.

When the chops are done in the oven, heat 1 tablespoon oil in 12-inch heavy-bottomed skillet over high heat until smoking. Place chops in a skillet and sear until well browned and crusty, 1 to 2 minutes, lifting once halfway through to redistribute fat underneath each chop. (Reduce heat if browned bits in pan bottom start to burn.) Using tongs, turn chops and cook until well browned on second side, another 1 to 2 minutes.
Transfer chops and any accumulated juices to the cabbage pan, remove pan from heat and let them rest, loosely tented with foil or the pan lid for about 10 minutes.
